title: Mangry's mod
description: This mod used in my modpack.
body:
- This mod was created for my modpack and uploaded here for easier updates and access.
If you'd like to use it in your own project, please credit me and the contributors listed below (with links to their original mods).

- What does this mod do?
This mod adds compatibility between various other mods by assigning level requirements that match the theme of the modpack. It also includes some small additions, such as removing certain advancements and adding custom ones.

- Credits:
[Even more LevelZ support](https://modrinth.com/datapack/even-more-levelz-support),
